objectives: Studenta will integrate scientific knowledge from diverse sources in the planning and conduct of field investigations.
Students will demonstrate knowledge of the basic principles of human biology, disease pathology, and its related social determinants of health in the development of a field investigation.
Students will describe the key phases of planning and conducting an outbreak or cluster investigation and define the key aims of the investigation.

Students will conduct analysis and develop inferences supported by the study findings including the use of appropriate statistical methods.
